name: Demo E4: Modeled Duct Tap Branch Redline
description: Run one bounded modeled duct tap redline through /revit/connect-mep-branch and require tap projection, branch and fitting model ids, connector/system audit, visual gate, and cleanup evidence.
setup_instructions: Open the target Revit model and the sheet/view containing a smaller duct branch redline into a main duct.
Use a prepared deterministic request with a verified main duct id, projected tap point on the main, branch endpoint points, duct size, level, and system.
Use /revit/connect-mep-branch with connectionMode=tap, apply=true, verify=true, and visualVerify=true; do not report completion from a dry-run.
success_criteria: /revit/connect-mep-branch returns an applied/created status and is not scaffold-only.
The result reports created branch duct ids and takeoff/tap fitting ids.
The projected tap point is reported and matches the requested point within tolerance.
Requested branch duct size is read back after the model write.
A connected fitting attempt and connector/network audit are reported.
A focused post-change capture is returned and the redline visual gate passes.
Created disposable branch/fitting ids are proven in a cleanup dry-run and then deleted after verification evidence is recorded.
failure_criteria: The workflow only dry-runs, reports scaffoldOnly=true, or returns no model write ids.
The projected tap point is missing or off target.
The requested branch duct size readback is missing or mismatched.
No connected fitting attempt or connector/network audit is reported.
The focused visual capture is missing.
The redline visual gate is fail or uncertain.
Cleanup is requested but created branch/fitting ids are missing from cleanup evidence.
grader_notes: This benchmark covers one safe duct tap/takeoff case first. It does not yet prove pipe top taps, tee splitting, size transitions, or complex multi-branch routing.
optional_cleanup_steps: Delete created branch/fitting ids after visual verification so repeated live reliability runs do not accumulate model clutter.
